entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Geez. Christmas Eve really clogs[n]this place up.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Didn't think all the restaurants[n]would be totally booked...
I should've made reservations.
We can still enjoy the cake.
I'm fine if I've got you.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Relax. I'm the one who dragged you[n]all the way out here.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: We still wanted to get a cake, right?

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Heh... That's true.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: God, it's been years since I had[n]Christmas cake.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: ...Where do you learn these lines?

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Cake first, though, right? Once we've[n]got that, you can feed me all the cheesy[n]schlock you want.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Let's go look for one.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: I wouldn't get your hopes up...

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: You wouldn't happen to have any[n]Christmas cakes left, would you?

entries.speaker: Cheerful Female Employee
entries.en: Actually, we do!

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: What?

entries.speaker: Cheerful Female Employee
entries.en: One of our orders was canceled last-[n]minute. This is the only cake we have!

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Well, in that case...

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: We'd like to buy it.

entries.speaker: Cheerful Female Employee
entries.en: Of course! Just wait one moment[n]while I go prepare your order!

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Can you believe that?
I'm starving.
I can hardly wait.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Slow down.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: We'll get to enjoy it soon.[n]Just the two of us.
